claim.claim-text: The megastructure of Claim 62, wherein said degraded terrain (2200) comprises an abandoned open-pit mine or tailings basin, and said thermo-cavitation plasma modules (2302) mineralize Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) and per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) into inert vitrified slag (2306) with zero liquid outfall.

The megastructure of Claim 62, wherein said degraded terrain (2200) comprises a coastal alkali sabkha or salt flat, and said cold-sink heat exchangers (2304) couple to deep ocean seawater to co-produce battery-grade lithium carbonate (Li2CO3) and magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)2) (2306) without hypersaline brine discharge.

The megastructure of Claim 62, wherein said subterranean freight conduit (2214) connects to automated vertical shuttle shafts (2310) configured to deliver temperature-controlled food and commerce goods from said vertical farms (2210) directly into individual residential pantries along said staggered terraces (2204) within 15 minutes.

The method of Claim 66, wherein said degraded terrain (2200) comprises sub-zero permafrost barrens supported on thermal-break foundation piers (2216) that prevent permafrost thaw while harvesting ambient -35 C cold-sink thermal differentials and oxidizing thermokarst methane plumes.
